subject: SCIENCE
title: Homes That Meet Needs
introduction: A suitable environment provides the particular resources and conditions an organism needs. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: Everything around us — land, water, and air.
The place where a person or animal lives.
Something you must have to live, like food and water.

activities.instruction: Study the idea and listen to the narration.
